title: ReconstructRequest
description: POST /api/reconstruct is a multipart/form-data request (not JSON), so this schema describes the logical shape of its fields for validation/documentation purposes. 'image' is a binary file part, present only when modality='image'.

modality.description: Which pipeline to run. Determines whether 'image' or 'text' is required.

text.description: Required when modality='text': the AI-generated text output to reconstruct a prompt from.

top_k.description: Number of candidate prompts to retrieve.

include_regeneration.description: Whether to run the (slow) reconstruction-consistency step (Task 6.1: regenerate an image/text from the reconstructed prompt and re-embed it). Defaults to false to keep the request fast.
